what: Planned collector failure exclusions use output-family names, but failure logs are generated from slot names
scenario_or_breakage: Codex static failures write codex-plan-*-collector.failure.log and dynamic failures write dyn-cursor-plan-*-collector.failure.log or dyn-codex-plan-*-collector.failure.log; a codex-primary-plan-*-collector.failure.log deny arm will miss those logs and publish stderr/transcript snippets
suggested_fix: Add deny arms and fixtures for the real slot-name failure logs: codex-plan-*-collector.failure.log, dyn-cursor-plan-*-collector.failure.log, dyn-codex-plan-*-collector.failure.log, plus the existing cursor, claude, and unknown-slot cases
